podcast.body: This song was crucial in bringing techno music out of Detroit and into the global spotlight. Released in 1987, it precipitated the genre's explosion beyond its origins, leading to its discovery in Europe, where it became incredibly popular. "Esa canción de The Rikmai fue la que precipitó todo y la que sacó el techno de Detroit."
